description: End-to-end finite element analysis in MATLAB PDE Toolbox — geometry creation, model setup, solve, and post-processing in one skill. Use when building geometry from primitives or file import, setting up femodel with BCs/loads/materials, solving thermal/structural/EM problems, and extracting or visualizing results. Covers fegeometry, multicuboid, multicylinder, multisphere, decsg, boolean ops, mesh generation, femodel, all AnalysisTypes (thermalSteady, thermalTransient, structuralStatic, structuralTransient, structuralModal, structuralFrequency, electrostatic, magnetostatic, dcConduction, harmonic EM), materialProperties, faceBC, faceLoad, cellLoad, vertexLoad, solve, interpolation, von Mises stress, principal stress, reaction forces, heat flux, pdeplot3D visualization. Triggers on: PDE Toolbox, finite element, FEA, thermal analysis, structural analysis, electromagnetic analysis, femodel, mesh, boundary conditions, stress, displacement, heat transfer, post-processing.
